check.name: check_porcentaje
check.definition: ((((tipo_contrato)::text = 'PORCENTAJE'::text) AND (porcentaje_chofer IS NOT NULL) AND ((porcentaje_chofer >= (0)::numeric) AND (porcentaje_chofer <= (100)::numeric))) OR (((tipo_contrato)::text <> 'PORCENTAJE'::text) AND (porcentaje_chofer IS NULL)))

check.name: ck_contrato_activo_estado
check.definition: ((((estado_contrato)::text = 'ACTIVO'::text) AND (activo = true)) OR (((estado_contrato)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDIENTE_CONFIGURACION'::character varying, 'PROGRAMADO'::character varying, 'FINALIZADO'::character varying])::text[])) AND (activo = false)))

check.name: ck_contrato_dia_inicio_semana
check.definition: (((dia_inicio_semana)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['lunes'::character varying, 'martes'::character varying, 'miercoles'::character varying, 'jueves'::character varying, 'viernes'::character varying, 'sabado'::character varying, 'domingo'::character varying])::text[])) OR (dia_inicio_semana IS NULL))

check.name: ck_contrato_extension_valida
check.definition: (((permite_extension = false) AND (hora_fin_extension IS NULL)) OR ((permite_extension = true) AND (hora_fin_extension IS NOT NULL)))

check.name: ck_contrato_horario_valido
check.definition: ((hora_fin IS NULL) OR (hora_inicio IS NULL) OR (hora_fin <> hora_inicio))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_ck_viaje_calidad_min
check.definition: ((calidad_minima_vehiculo IS NULL) OR ((calidad_minima_vehiculo)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['regular'::character varying, 'bueno'::character varying, 'excelente'::character varying])::text[])))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_ck_viaje_centro_costo_despacho
check.definition: ((origen_tipo IS NULL) OR ((origen_tipo)::text <> 'despacho_manual'::text) OR (centro_costo IS NOT NULL))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_ck_viaje_estado_cobro
check.definition: ((estado_cobro IS NULL) OR ((estado_cobro)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pendiente'::character varying, 'cobrado'::character varying, 'facturado'::character varying, 'pagado'::character varying])::text[])))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_ck_viaje_origen_tipo
check.definition: ((origen_tipo IS NULL) OR ((origen_tipo)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['plataforma'::character varying, 'via_publica'::character varying, 'qr_comercio'::character varying, 'corporativo'::character varying, 'despacho_manual'::character varying])::text[])))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_ck_viaje_responsable_cobro
check.definition: ((responsable_cobro IS NULL) OR ((responsable_cobro)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['chofer'::character varying, 'propietario'::character varying, 'tenant'::character varying, 'comercio'::character varying, 'empresa'::character varying])::text[])))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_ck_viaje_subestado_despacho
check.definition: ((subestado_despacho IS NULL) OR ((subestado_despacho)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['reservado'::character varying, 'despachado'::character varying, 'vehiculo_llego'::character varying, 'pasajero_a_bordo'::character varying, 'completado'::character varying])::text[])))

check.name: ck_viaje_solicitado_metodo_pago
check.definition: ((metodo_pago IS NULL) OR ((metodo_pago)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['efectivo'::character varying, 'tarjeta_debito'::character varying, 'qr'::character varying, 'transferencia'::character varying])::text[])))
